datasets.name: lake.cdc_events
datasets.description: Every change captured from the source, append-only and unique on seq. The source of truth for audit, replay and warehouse rebuilds.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

pii.treatment: raw values (unhashed email and phone in users rows)

schema.seq: BIGINT — Global change sequence number; unique; snapshot events use negative numbers
schema.schema_version: INTEGER — Contract version stamped by the capturing trigger
schema.op: VARCHAR — insert, update, delete or snapshot
schema.before: VARCHAR — Row image before the change as JSON; NULL on insert (contains raw PII)
schema.after: VARCHAR — Row image after the change as JSON; NULL on delete (contains raw PII)
schema.batch_id: VARCHAR — Pipeline batch that ingested the event
schema.ingested_at: TIMESTAMP — When the event was ingested
schema.contract_version: INTEGER — Contract version active at ingestion

datasets.example_query: SELECT table_name, op, count(*) AS events FROM lake.cdc_events GROUP BY table_name, op ORDER BY table_name, op

datasets.name: warehouse.users
datasets.description: Customer accounts (latest state). Email and phone are hashed.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.name: VARCHAR — Display name
schema.email_hash: VARCHAR — SHA-256 of the lower-cased, trimmed email (PII)
schema.phone_hash: VARCHAR — SHA-256 of the lower-cased, trimmed phone number (PII); NULL when no phone
schema.status: VARCHAR — Account status: active, suspended or closed
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was created (source time, UTC)
schema.updated_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was last updated (source time, UTC)

datasets.example_query: SELECT status, count(*) AS users FROM warehouse.users GROUP BY status

datasets.name: warehouse.products
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.sku: VARCHAR — Stock-keeping unit, unique per product
schema.name: VARCHAR — Display name
schema.price: DECIMAL(18,2) — Unit price in rupees (source paise / 100)
schema.status: VARCHAR — Product status: active or discontinued
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was created (source time, UTC)
schema.updated_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was last updated (source time, UTC)

datasets.example_query: SELECT category, avg(price) AS avg_price FROM warehouse.products GROUP BY category

datasets.name: warehouse.inventory
datasets.description: Stock on hand and reserved per product (latest state).
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.product_id: VARCHAR — Product the stock belongs to
schema.reserved: BIGINT — Units reserved by pending or paid orders
schema.updated_at: TIMESTAMP — When the stock last changed

datasets.example_query: SELECT product_id, on_hand - reserved AS available FROM warehouse.inventory ORDER BY available

datasets.name: warehouse.wallets
datasets.description: In-app wallets, one per user, with current balance.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.user_id: VARCHAR — Owning user (one wallet per user)
schema.status: VARCHAR — Wallet status: active, frozen or closed
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was created (source time, UTC)
schema.updated_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was last updated (source time, UTC)

datasets.example_query: SELECT sum(balance) AS total_wallet_balance FROM warehouse.wallets

datasets.name: warehouse.wallet_transactions
datasets.description: Append-only wallet ledger: top-ups, payment debits and refund credits.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.type: VARCHAR — Ledger entry type: topup, payment_debit or refund_credit
schema.balance_after: DECIMAL(18,2) — Wallet balance in rupees after this ledger entry
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the ledger entry was written

datasets.example_query: SELECT type, sum(amount) AS total FROM warehouse.wallet_transactions GROUP BY type

datasets.name: warehouse.orders
datasets.description: Orders with status lifecycle and timestamps (latest state).
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.status: VARCHAR — Order status: pending, paid, cancelled, shipped, delivered, partially_refunded or refunded
schema.placed_at: TIMESTAMP — When the order was placed
schema.paid_at: TIMESTAMP — When the order became fully paid
schema.delivered_at: TIMESTAMP — When the order was delivered
schema.cancelled_at: TIMESTAMP — When the order was cancelled
schema.updated_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was last updated (source time, UTC)

datasets.example_query: SELECT status, count(*) AS orders, sum(total) AS revenue FROM warehouse.orders GROUP BY status

datasets.name: warehouse.order_items
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.line_no: BIGINT — Line number within the order
schema.unit_price: DECIMAL(18,2) — Unit price in rupees at order time
schema.line_total: DECIMAL(18,2) — quantity x unit_price in rupees

datasets.example_query: SELECT product_id, sum(quantity) AS units_sold FROM warehouse.order_items GROUP BY product_id

datasets.name: warehouse.payments
datasets.description: Every payment attempt (wallet, card, UPI), including failed ones.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.method: VARCHAR — Payment method: wallet, card or upi
schema.status: VARCHAR — Payment attempt status: initiated, success or failed
schema.wallet_txn_id: VARCHAR — Ledger entry of a successful wallet payment
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the payment attempt started
schema.completed_at: TIMESTAMP — When the payment attempt completed

datasets.example_query: SELECT method, status, sum(amount) AS amount FROM warehouse.payments GROUP BY method, status

datasets.name: warehouse.refunds
datasets.description: Refund requests and their processing, paid back to the original method.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.payment_id: VARCHAR — Original payment the refund goes back to
schema.status: VARCHAR — Refund status: requested, approved, rejected or processed
schema.provider_ref: VARCHAR — Gateway reference of a card/UPI refund
schema.wallet_txn_id: VARCHAR — Ledger entry of a wallet refund
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the refund was requested
schema.processed_at: TIMESTAMP — When the refund was processed

datasets.example_query: SELECT status, count(*) AS refunds, sum(amount) AS amount FROM warehouse.refunds GROUP BY status

datasets.name: warehouse.users_history
datasets.description: Every version of each users row (SCD2) for point-in-time questions and audit; valid_from / valid_to are source commit times.
datasets.update_cadence: Every pipeline cycle (adaptive polling, 0.2 s - 5 s idle back-off); at most one cycle behind the source

schema.name: VARCHAR — Display name
schema.email_hash: VARCHAR — SHA-256 of the lower-cased, trimmed email (PII)
schema.phone_hash: VARCHAR — SHA-256 of the lower-cased, trimmed phone number (PII); NULL when no phone
schema.status: VARCHAR — Account status: active, suspended or closed
schema.created_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was created (source time, UTC)
schema.updated_at: TIMESTAMP — When the row was last updated (source time, UTC)
schema.valid_from: TIMESTAMP — Start of validity: source commit time of this version
schema.valid_to: TIMESTAMP — End of validity (next version's valid_from); NULL while open
schema.is_current: BOOLEAN — TRUE for the latest live version of the row
schema.op: VARCHAR — Change operation: insert, update, delete or snapshot
schema.seq: BIGINT — Global change sequence number from the source change_log
schema._schema_version: INTEGER — Contract version the change was captured under

datasets.example_query: SELECT * FROM warehouse.users_history WHERE is_current ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 10
